title: Project Manager - Financial Investors
description:
**About us:** 1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.

**About the role:**  
As a Project manager, you assume a great deal of responsibility to lead large delivery teams in 1Lattice in Financial Investors vertical, and to guide the entire research process and recommend solutions that make a real impact. You will have full ownership of the deliverables and assume leadership roles on your team - as such, your team's successes also enhance your own personal results story.  
Exposed to more complex client interactions, group manager plays a significant role in influencing senior level thinking and moving clients to action. You not only provide answers to questions and detail their strategic implications, but you are also encouraged to support our culture of giving back by motivating your colleagues and the firm at large to apply their talents to support a particular social cause.

**Roles and responsibilities:**  

* End to end ownership of project delivery leading high impact teams
* Driving though leadership in projects and coming up with compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to client problems
* Driving high quality research and analysis by teams
* Leading and delivering high quality client presentations in projects
* Managing scope and delivery of projects along with end to end client process management
* Understanding the client requirements and then customizing the project scope and services as per their needs
* Maintaining relationships with existing clients
* Coordinate with Financial Investors domain partners in the vertical to bring in their expertise into delivery
* Lead project delivery and manage delivery teams to drive customer wow and delight
* Work with delivery teams to create lasting impact through our engagement at clients
* Play active part in recruitment and build project delivery teams in your department

**Competencies and skills**:  

* Proven experience in Business Research, minimum 3 years leading and managing the team in research or consulting domain
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong ability to research, analyse and communicate key commercial value drivers
* Excellent communication and client management skills
* Ability to understand client's needs and developing trusted relationships
* Demonstrated ability to execute/project manage large-scale research projects from beginning to completion
* Understanding of the consulting and research market types of offerings
* Expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies and experienced in developing market-based research
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach
* Ability to workplan, define scope and approach for assignments
* Ability to guide and monitor project delivery teams, existing relationships in the domain of interest with senior client prospects
* Ability to influence and lead pitches

**Educational qualification and Certifications:**  

* Consistent track record of academic excellence
* Demonstration of leadership in educational and professional career
* Very high drive and energy
* Graduate degree with strong academic performance

title: Senior Manager - Project Management
description:
At American Express, colleagues work together to deliver trusted products, services, and experiences for customers and merchants. This role offers the opportunity to shape important servicing capabilities, collaborate across a global organization, and lead programs with visible merchant, colleague, operational, and business impact.

The Senior Manager, Project Management will lead a portfolio of strategic initiatives supporting American Express Merchant Servicing. This role will be responsible for delivering complex, cross-functional programs that improve the merchant experience, strengthen operational performance and controls, increase digital adoption, and enable scalable servicing capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong program-management discipline with a deep understanding of servicing operations and customer journeys. They will work across Merchant Servicing, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Analytics, and other global teams to translate strategic priorities into executable plans and measurable business outcomes.

This is a highly visible role requiring sound judgment, executive-level communication, structured problem-solving, and the ability to influence stakeholders in a complex global organization.

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Approximately 10 or more years of experience in project management, program management, business transformation, operations, consulting, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, complex, cross-functional programs in a matrixed organization.
* Experience supporting financial services, payments, merchant acquiring, customer servicing, contact-center operations, fintech, or another regulated industry.
* Strong command of project and program-management disciplines, including planning, governance, dependency management, risk and issue management, change control, and benefits realization.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver results without direct authority over all contributing teams.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience preparing materials for senior-management forums.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to convert data and complex information into actionable recommendations.
* Working knowledge of operational-risk, control, compliance, privacy, and information-security considerations.
* Experience managing multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
* Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams and provide reasonable overlap with global business hours when required.
* Proficiency with standard productivity and project-management tools such as Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or comparable platforms.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Project Manager (Civil Engineer)
description:
Job Description – Project Manager (Civil Engineering)Job Description: Project Manager – Civil Engineering

**Position:** Project Manager – Civil  
**Industry:** Construction \& Real Estate  
**Experience:** 8–15 years  
**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering  
**Location:** Shimla  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Project Manager – Civil** to lead and manage construction projects from planning and execution through completion and handover.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in **civil engineering and project management**, with proven experience handling **residential developments, government projects, high\-rise buildings, and luxury villas**. The candidate should be capable of managing multiple stakeholders, contractors, consultants, budgets, timelines, quality, and site execution while ensuring projects are delivered safely and to the required standards.

Key ResponsibilitiesProject Planning \& Execution

* Plan, coordinate, and manage projects from pre\-construction through completion and handover.
* Develop project execution plans, schedules, milestones, manpower plans, and resource requirements.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules and take corrective action where required.
* Ensure construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, and contractual requirements.
* Coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, finishing, and external development works.
* Ensure effective sequencing and coordination of various construction activities.

Site \& Construction Management

* Provide overall leadership to site teams, engineers, supervisors, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Review construction methodologies and ensure proper execution at site.
* Monitor productivity, manpower, material utilization, and equipment deployment.
* Resolve technical and execution\-related issues in coordination with consultants and design teams.
* Ensure proper coordination between structural, architectural, MEP, and finishing works.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress review meetings.

Project Controls \& Cost Management

* Monitor project budgets, BOQs, quantities, variations, and costs.
* Review contractor bills, measurements, work orders, and material requirements.
* Identify potential cost overruns and delays and implement corrective measures.
* Monitor project cash flow and expenditure against approved budgets.
* Evaluate variations, additional works, and claims in coordination with the commercial team.

Quality \& Safety

* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, quality standards, drawings, and applicable codes.
* Establish and monitor quality\-control procedures throughout the project.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, snagging, rectification, and final handover.
* Ensure strict compliance with site safety requirements and statutory regulations.

Client, Consultant \& Government Coordination

* Act as the primary project\-level point of contact for clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with government authorities and statutory agencies wherever required.
* Manage project meetings and ensure timely closure of action points.
* Prepare and present regular project progress reports to senior management/client.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Review drawings, specifications, BOQs, contracts, schedules, and technical documentation.
* Maintain project records, progress reports, approvals, RFIs, inspection records, and correspondence.
* Track project milestones and provide regular updates on schedule, cost, quality, and risks.
* Ensure proper documentation for project completion, testing, commissioning, and handover.

Required Project Experience

Candidates should ideally have hands\-on experience in one or more of the following:

* **Residential apartment projects**
* **High\-rise residential buildings**
* **Luxury villas and premium residences**
* **Government construction/infrastructure projects**
* Large\-scale residential developments
* RCC framed structures and structural works
* Architectural finishing and high\-end interior coordination
* MEP coordination and integrated building services
* External development and infrastructure works

Experience managing projects involving **multiple contractors, consultants, government authorities, and high\-value clients** will be an advantage.

Key Skills \& Competencies

* Strong knowledge of civil construction and structural works
* Project planning and scheduling
* Site management and execution
* Cost and budget control
* Contractor and subcontractor management
* BOQ, quantity estimation, billing, and variation management
* Quality assurance and quality control
* Health \& safety management
* Risk and issue management
* Client and consultant coordination
* Team leadership and manpower management
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making ability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under project deadlines

Software Skills

Proficiency in relevant construction/project management tools such as:

* MS Project / Primavera P6
* AutoCAD
* MS Excel and MS Office
* Project reporting and documentation tools

Educational \& Experience Requirements

* **B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering** from a recognized institution.
* **8–15 years of relevant construction/project management experience.**
* Proven experience managing medium to large\-scale construction projects.
* Candidates with experience in **high\-rise residential, luxury villas, government projects, or premium real estate developments** will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of construction practices, project planning, contracts, quality, safety, and statutory requirements.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a **hands\-on Project Manager who combines strong civil engineering expertise with practical project leadership skills**.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working between the **site, consultants, contractors, clients, senior management, and government authorities**, and should have a demonstrated ability to deliver projects within **time, cost, quality, and safety parameters**.

Leadership \| Ownership \| Technical Expertise \| Planning \| Execution \| Cost Consciousness \| Problem Solving \| Stakeholder Management \| Quality Focus \| Safety Focus

title: PMO Analyst
description:
**Position Summary:**  

The Analyst \- PMO (GCC) is a critical execution\-layer role within the Program Management Office, responsible for supporting end\-to\-end program governance, process documentation, knowledge transfer (KT) coordination, and data management across the GCC delivery lifecycle. The incumbent will act as a custodian of program master data, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and timely updates across all program repositories.
This role requires a detail\-oriented professional who can translate business requirements into structured records, design SOPs and process flows, track KT milestones, and provide advanced Excel\-based reporting support across multiple interlinked trackers and stakeholder files. The analyst will interface closely with vendors, project teams, functional leads, and business stakeholders to drive operational accuracy and process compliance.  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* **Master Data \& Program Governance:**
  

* Own and maintain program master files and working trackers throughout the program lifecycle.
* Ensure all records remain accurate, structured, and aligned with current business requirements.
* Perform regular data validation and quality checks across all program repositories.
* Support governance reviews and audits through accurate maintenance of program information.
* Maintain version control and change logs for master files to enable traceability.

  

* **Requirement Intake \& Management:**
  

* Capture, validate, and enter new business requirements into relevant master files and tracking systems.
* Maintain complete and up\-to\-date requirement records with status, owner, and resolution details.
* Track requirement lifecycle from intake to closure and flag overdue or unresolved items.
* Support periodic reporting on requirement status for stakeholder reviews.
* Coordinate with business owners to clarify, prioritize, and close requirement backlogs.

  

* **Vendor \& Unique ID Governance:**
  

* Allocate vendors and unique identifiers based on approved functional and sub\-functional mappings.
* Maintain consistency and accuracy of vendor allocation records across all program trackers.
* Ensure traceability and governance compliance for all vendor\-related mapping information.
* Support audit readiness through well\-maintained vendor and ID allocation logs.
* Escalate mapping conflicts or anomalies to the PMO Lead for timely resolution.

  

* **SOP Design \& Process Documentation:**
  

* Design and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for KT, onboarding, and operational processes.
* Translate business requirements into structured process documentation and workflow diagrams.
* Create swimlane diagrams, process flowcharts, and RACI matrices as required.
* Periodically review and update SOPs to reflect process changes or improvements.
* Maintain a centralized process documentation repository accessible to all stakeholders.

  

* **Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination \& Tracking:**
  

* Review submitted KT forms and trackers to verify completeness and accuracy.
* Monitor KT schedules and completion status against agreed timelines and milestones.
* Follow up with candidates, vendors, and team leads to ensure timely KT execution.
* Escalate delays, risks, or compliance issues impacting KT progress to the PMO Lead.
* Maintain KT governance records, status dashboards, and exception reports for leadership reviews.

  

* **Advanced Excel \& Reporting Support:**
  

* Develop and maintain complex Excel\-based trackers: master files, candidate files, and vendor files.
* Troubleshoot issues across interlinked workbooks — including two candidate files and two vendor files linked to master files.
* Build and maintain XLOOKUP / INDEX\-MATCH formulas, pivot tables, dynamic dashboards, and data validation rules.
* Ensure data integrity and consistency across all linked reporting files.
* Automate repetitive reporting tasks using advanced Excel features such as Power Query and macros where applicable.

  

* **Stakeholder Reporting \& Presentations:**
  

* Prepare management\-ready reports and PowerPoint presentations for governance reviews and milestone meetings.
* Convert complex tracker data into executive\-level dashboards and visual summaries.
* Support weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reporting requirements for program leadership.
* Maintain presentation templates and ensure consistency of formatting across all program decks.

  

**Educational Qualification:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Engineering, Information Systems, Operations Management, or a related field.
* MBA or Post\-Graduate Diploma in Management (preferred).

  

**Work Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in PMO, Process Excellence, Shared Services, GCC, Reporting, or Program Coordination roles.
* Prior experience in a Global Capability Center (GCC) or Offshore Delivery Center environment preferred.
* Exposure to cross\-functional stakeholder management and multi\-vendor program environments.
* Experience in Knowledge Transfer (KT) coordination or transition management is a strong advantage.

  

**Functional Skills**
* Data Governance \& Master Data Management
* Requirement Management \& Lifecycle Tracking
* Knowledge Transfer (KT) Coordination \& Tracking
* Vendor Mapping \& Unique ID Governance
* SOP Development \& Process Documentation
* Program Governance \& Compliance Reporting
* Advanced Reporting \& Analytics
* Stakeholder Communication \& Escalation Management

title: Project Delivery Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Project Managers serve as the single point of contact between the Operations and Commercial teams, tasked with executing our market research services from start to finish. Project Managers convert Commercial/Client analytical inputs into high\-quality survey materials, maintain project timing and scheduling systems, perform quality checks, and coordinate between internal and external stakeholders to fulfill market research project requirements.


RESPONSIBILITIES

* Review questionnaire input forms and study materials for accuracy, completeness, and logical consistency, proactively resolving any discrepancies with Commercial and Client Service teams.
* Program and configure online surveys within NIQ's proprietary survey platform using approved concepts, stimuli, and finalized questionnaire specifications.
* Coordinate translation requirements with internal and external translation partners to ensure timely delivery of localized survey materials.
* Conduct thorough quality assurance (QA) testing of programmed surveys to validate routing, logic, quotas, stimuli display, and respondent experience before launch.
* Configure survey routing solutions and vendor integrations, including setup and deployment through approved sample providers and panel platforms.
* Launch, monitor, and manage fieldwork activities, ensuring respondent quotas, timelines, and quality standards are achieved.
* Identify fieldwork risks and implement corrective actions, including onboarding additional sample sources or vendors when required.
* Track project costs and fieldwork performance to ensure studies are delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Client Service and Commercial teams during study setup and fieldwork execution.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve survey, programming, sampling, or fieldwork issues efficiently.

title: Program Manager, Climate Operations
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience with carbon accounting and methodologies or energy markets.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in climate science, Green House Gas (GHG) Standards and accounting, or the energy industry.
* 8 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data\-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C\-Suite level.
* High\-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate\-related goals.


In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high\-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross\-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.  

The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Project Manager** to lead and manage software development projects from planning through delivery. The ideal candidate should have a strong technical understanding, excellent project management skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, product, and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, manage, and deliver software projects within defined **scope, timeline, and budget**.
* Coordinate with developers, designers, QA engineers, DevOps, and stakeholders.
* Define project requirements, milestones, deliverables, and timelines.
* Break projects into tasks and assign responsibilities to team members.
* Track project progress, identify risks, and resolve blockers.
* Conduct regular **stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives**.
* Communicate project status, progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
* Manage technical dependencies and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
* Work closely with developers to understand technical challenges and requirements.
* Ensure projects follow development, testing, security, and deployment processes.
* Manage scope changes and prioritize tasks based on business requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve development and project delivery processes.
* Maintain project documentation, timelines, reports, and technical specifications.

Required Skills

* Strong understanding of **software development lifecycle (SDLC)**.
* Experience with **Agile/Scrum** methodologies.
* Good understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, cloud, and software architecture.
* Experience with project management tools such as **Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar**.
* Strong communication, leadership, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, risk management, and resource management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Good to Have

* Technical background in **JavaScript, Node.js, React, Python, Java**, or similar technologies.
* Experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, CI/CD**, and DevOps workflows.
* Experience managing API integrations, AI projects, or cloud\-based applications.
* Familiarity with Git and software release management.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or other relevant project management certification.

Experience

**1–7 years** of experience in technical project management, software development, or a related field, with experience managing software development teams.

What We’re Looking For

A technically strong and organized project manager who can bridge the gap between **business requirements and technical execution**, keep teams aligned, proactively manage risks, and ensure successful project delivery.
